title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Strengthening Judicial Protection of the Lawful Rights and Interests of "Red Classics" and Heroes and Martyrs and Promoting Socialist Core Values
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Strengthening Judicial Protection of the Legitimate Rights and Interests of "Red Classics" and Heroes and Martyrs to Promote Core Socialist Values

Fa [2018] No. 68

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

In order to comprehensively implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era and the guiding principles of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Second and Third Plenary Sessions of the 19th Central Committee, to thoroughly implement the "Opinions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Cultivating and Practicing Core Socialist Values," to lawfully protect the inheritance of red classics and the legitimate rights and interests of heroes and martyrs, to advocate for taste, style, and responsibility, to educate and guide the public, especially the youth, to consciously resist "vulgarity, kitsch, and pandering," to resist historical nihilism, to regulate improper dissemination behaviors, to safeguard the public interest, and to guide local people's courts at all levels in correctly adjudicating cases involving disputes over the protection of red classic inheritance and the legitimate rights and interests of heroes and martyrs, thereby promoting core socialist values, in accordance with the relevant provisions of the General Provisions of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Protection of Heroes and Martyrs, and intellectual property laws, the following notice is hereby issued:

I. Fully Recognize the Great Significance of Protecting Red Classics and the Legitimate Rights and Interests of Heroes and Martyrs

Under the leadership of the Communist Party of China, numerous red classics have been created and countless heroes and martyrs have emerged during the long period of revolutionary war, the socialist construction era, and the reform and opening-up process. They represent the precious spiritual wealth of our Party and country, and are outstanding representatives of the Chinese people. The spiritual values they embody constitute the common historical memory of the Chinese nation, the common value pursuit of all Chinese people, and an important source of core socialist values. Lawfully protecting the inheritance of red classics and the legitimate rights and interests of heroes and martyrs means safeguarding the fundamental interests of the broadest masses of the people and promoting core socialist values. This is the sacred mission and major responsibility of the people's courts in their trial work, and an inevitable requirement for comprehensively implementing General Secretary Xi Jinping's call to "better build Chinese spirit, Chinese values, and Chinese strength, and provide spiritual guidance for the people." It must be done with unwavering clarity and firmness in lawfully protecting the inheritance of red classics and the legitimate rights and interests of heroes and martyrs. It is necessary to correctly handle the relationship between protecting red classics and the legitimate rights and interests of heroes and martyrs, on the one hand, and promoting the prosperity and development of socialist culture, on the other hand—respecting history, respecting classics, and honoring heroes and martyrs. Through trial work, the people's courts shall inspire the national pride of the broad masses of the people, strengthen the "Four Consciousnesses" (confidence in the path, theory, system, and culture of socialism with Chinese characteristics), and provide a powerful spiritual impetus for building a prosperous, strong, democratic, culturally advanced, harmonious, and beautiful modern socialist country and realizing the Chinese Dream of the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

II. Lawfully and Properly Adjudicate Cases Involving Disputes over Remuneration for the Use of Red Classic Works and Disputes over the Legitimate Rights and Interests of Heroes and Martyrs

It is necessary to deeply understand the special nature of cases involving disputes over remuneration for the use of red classic works and disputes over the legitimate rights and interests of heroes and martyrs. When determining infringement, calculating remuneration, and ordering cessation of conduct, the principles of respecting history, respecting the law, and respecting rights shall be adhered to, and the balancing of interests in the judicial protection of red classics and the legitimate rights and interests of heroes and martyrs shall be maintained. In order to safeguard the interests of the Party and the state and the public interest, in cases of disputes over remuneration arising from the use of red classic works, the court shall not order the cessation of the performance or showing of such red classic works. When determining the remuneration for red classic works, a distinction shall be made from other commodified works whose transaction prices and remuneration calculation methods are primarily determined by the market. Comprehensive consideration shall be given to factors such as the type of red classic work, the actual circumstances of performance or showing, and the proportion of the red classic work used in derivative works. At the same time, full consideration shall be given to the special historical background under which the red classic was created, and, with a view to facilitating the inheritance of red classics and the dissemination of the heroic deeds of heroes and martyrs, a reasonable amount of remuneration shall be determined as appropriate, avoiding simplistic calculations of monetary payments.

III. Effectively Safeguard the Litigation Rights of Interested Parties Related to Red Classics and Heroes and Martyrs

In accordance with the provisions of the Copyright Law, authors of red classic works enjoy the rights of authorship, modification, and integrity of their original works. The term of protection for these moral rights is not limited in time, and others may not exercise them without explicit authorization. If a right holder or an interested party lawfully initiates a lawsuit with a people's court, the people's court shall accept the case.

If the author of an infringed red classic work has died and his or her interested parties have not initiated a lawsuit, or if the name, portrait, reputation, or honor of a hero or martyr has been infringed and there are no close relatives or the close relatives have not initiated a lawsuit, and a procuratorial authority or other authority or relevant organization prescribed by law initiates a lawsuit with a people's court, the people's court may accept the case by reference to Article 55 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China.

For parties who initiate lawsuits to protect red classics and the legitimate rights and interests of heroes and martyrs, if they have genuine difficulty in paying litigation costs and apply for a reduction, deferral, or exemption of such costs, the people's court shall provide support.

IV. Lawfully and Correctly Define the Rights and Obligations of Both Parties in Red Classic Litigation and the Legitimate Rights and Interests of Heroes and Martyrs

It is necessary to lawfully and correctly define the types of red classic works protected by copyright law, and on this basis, accurately identify the nature and categories of different rights. Where copyright is infringed, the specific scope of the infringed moral or property rights shall be clearly identified, such as the right of authorship, the right of modification, the right of integrity, and the right to receive remuneration. Where rights related to copyright are infringed, the specific scope of the infringed rights shall be clearly identified, such as the rights of performers, producers of sound recordings and video recordings, and broadcasting organizations. Where the Trademark Law or the Anti-Unfair Competition Law is violated, the corresponding rights and interests shall be clearly defined.

The advantages of the "three-in-one" mechanism of civil, administrative, and criminal intellectual property adjudication shall be fully utilized, correctly grasping the differences in the application of civil liability, administrative liability, and criminal liability in law, and accurately determining the civil, administrative, and criminal liability to be borne for infringing relevant rights, thereby continuously improving the overall effectiveness of judicial protection of red classics and the legitimate rights and interests of heroes and martyrs.

V. Actively and Collaboratively Promote Judicial Protection of Red Classics and the Legitimate Rights and Interests of Heroes and Martyrs

Protecting red classics and the legitimate rights and interests of heroes and martyrs requires the collaborative efforts of the whole society. For major, difficult, and sensitive issues encountered in the trial of cases, local people's courts at all levels shall conduct in-depth investigation and research, give full play to the role of the people's juror system, extensively solicit opinions from all sectors, including cultural and propaganda departments and copyright administrative departments, and higher-level courts shall strengthen professional guidance to lower-level courts, ensuring that the facts of the case are clearly ascertained, the law is correctly applied, and the judgment results respect history, conform to the law, and accord with national conditions, social conditions, and public opinion, fully demonstrating the combination of socialist rule of law and rule of virtue, and striving to achieve unity of legal and social effects in case handling.

Local people's courts at all levels shall strengthen organizational leadership, actively conduct public opinion guidance in accordance with the requirements of the "Three Synchronizations" (synchronizing case handling, news release, and public opinion guidance), and promptly report new situations and new problems to the Supreme People's Court level by level.

This notice is hereby given.

May 11, 2018
